Class ElementalStatusEffect

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect
io.github.xrickastley.sevenelements.effect.ElementalStatusEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityAwareEffect, FabricMobEffect, net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement
Direct Known Subclasses:
CryoStatusEffect, FrozenStatusEffect
public abstract sealed class ElementalStatusEffect extends net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect permits CryoStatusEffect, FrozenStatusEffect
A special subclass of MobEffect that is tied to an Element.

This subclass of MobEffect will persist on the entity it is inflicted on so long as its corresponding element is applied onto the entity.
